name: hiresprint
description: HIRESPRINT — AI-Powered Group Discussion and Learning Management Portal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c blue,green "npm.cmd run dev -w client" "npm.cmd run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm.cmd run build -w shared && npm.cmd run build -w server && npm.cmd run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm.cmd run build -w shared && npm.cmd run typecheck -w server && npm.cmd run typecheck -w client
